scope: Counterfactual original-source control: correct only mixed-grammar joke phonemes to the pinned official spelling, retaining .1 and all PCM/runtime settings.
policy: Reuse byte-identical model/PCM/placements,601blocks per case,.1threshold,500000ms timeout,command IDs and grammar texts. Stock remains unchanged. Only mixed command3 uses official phoneme_add with TfL Mm c qbK rather than automatic G2P TfL Mm d qbK; mixed commands1/2 retain G2P. Same reset/event/decoder/CRC policy. Do not modify from outcome.
upstream_protocol_relation: Pinned test_multinet.cpp directly calls esp_mn_commands_phoneme_add with TELL ME A JOKE and TfL Mm c qbK. This control uses that exact source-defined spelling and the preceding reference-v2 threshold/window. It is not a product wake or false-activation evaluation.
quality_gate: Both correlated placements must detect TELL ME A JOKE with ID1 in stock grammar and ID3 in mixed grammar. If not, investigate the harness/model contract before scoring Nyx quality.
source_partition_policy: Public upstream unit source is assigned only to training-side harness controls; no validation/final audio or new model fitting.
hypothesis: Does the independently source-defined weak-article phoneme c, rather than automatic letter-name d, restore the mixed-grammar known-source control while the stock arm reproduces its result?
